item.title: The Church Is Failing Marriages and Marriages Are Failing the Church
item.description: Have you ever stopped to consider that God is healing more than just your marriage? It's not only true for everyone reading this, it's biblically accurate. God is healing and restoring more than just you, more than just your spouse, more than just your marriage. He is pouring out a true revelation of His Bride!

item.title: Why God Won't Bless a Spouse's False Stand in Marriage Restoration
item.description: This message calls spouses to return to the fire that purifies, repent of idols hidden in the heart, and recognize that many are building in their own name while standing in their own strength. Derek contrasts the designed divide—God’s holy separation for purity and covenant identity—with the false divide—man’s self-righteous separation rooted in pride, religion, and control.

item.title: Pre-Marriage Wounds vs. In-Marriage Wounds: Why Knowing the Difference Can Save Your Marriage
item.description: You can not out run fruit.We can not run from fruit that grows from internal conditions.We see so many spouses who think that changing their location, their house, their relationships, their interests, their hobbies, their job, their focus, their morals, their activities, will heal their marriage.

item.title: You’re Not Sidelined by a Broken Marriage, You’re Training for the New One
item.description: Whether you’re sleeping in separate rooms, living under the same roof but disconnected, navigating a temporary break, or standing in the wreckage of a full separation — the same truth applies: You are not sidelined. You are being trained.

item.title: 3 Spiritual Shifts That Unlock a New Season of Marriage
item.description: In this episode, Derek and Jordan unpack one of the most overlooked seasons in marriage restoration — the season of becoming.
